response.sql:
WITH funding_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(p.fundflux, 'NULL') AS funding_source,
    AVG(
      CASE 
        WHEN sp.boxy IS NOT NULL AND sp.boxz IS NOT NULL AND sp.boxz != 0
        THEN sp.boxy / sp.boxz
      END
    ) AS avg_ratio,
    COUNT(*) AS size
  FROM projects p
  JOIN scanspatial sp ON p.arcregistry = sp.arcref
  GROUP BY COALESCE(p.fundflux, 'NULL')
),
stats_with_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    avg_ratio,
    size,
    AVG(size) OVER () AS avg_size
  FROM funding_stats
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_ratios,
  SUM(size) AS combined_size,
  AVG(size - avg_size) AS avg_excess
FROM stats_with_avg
WHERE size > avg_size

assumptions.assumption: "size" of a funding source is the count of scanspatial records associated with that funding source, not a sum of area/volume or other aggregate measure
"ignoring missing values" applies only to the ratio calculation; the size count includes all records regardless of whether boxy/boxz are NULL

alternatives.interpretation: "size" means the total area (sum of aream2) per funding source rather than record count

  SELECT 
    COALESCE(p.fundflux, 'NULL') AS funding_source,

      CASE

)

  AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_ratios,
  SUM(size) AS combined_size,
  AVG(size - avg_size) AS avg_excess
FROM stats_with_avg
WHERE size > avg_size
